summary: The house forge: git, packages, and the actions runners.
notes: A forge config change is never a rolling deploy. Two forge containers alive at once fight over the database lock, so every key here restarts by stop then start.

FORGEJO__storage__MINIO_ACCESS_KEY_ID.why: One half of the S3 key vault rotates. Vault answers both halves at once, so both keys carry the same rotation and hatchery runs it once.

FORGEJO__storage__MINIO_SECRET_ACCESS_KE.why: The other half of the same key. It declares the same rotation, because one issuer answers for both.

FORGE_PULL_TOKEN.why: The forge access token the boxes log in to the package registry with. The forge refuses token creation over its API, so a person issues this one.

issuer.recipe: Revoke the old token on the forge's token page. Mint a new one with package read. Then, on each box that pulls: dokku registry:login --password-stdin forgejo.jimmyhoughjr.net jimmy
